cases.scope: PR; adapt an existing client to an internal response wrapper
cases.requirements: Identifiers remain integers. The consumer must preserve navigation for supported responses.
cases.description: Read the identifier from the response wrapper.

    response = read()
    item = response.get('item', response)
    return '/objects/%d' % item['id']
